fields.title: Action Required
fields.subject: Action Required: Email Bounce Notification
fields.plain_text:
I am writing to inform you that recent emails sent to {{ email }} have consistently resulted in a delivery failure notification.

Could you please confirm if {{ name }} is still with your company?

If they are, please provide an updated or alternative email address for them. If they are no longer with the company, please remove them from your group as soon as possible.

Thank you for your prompt assistance with this matter.
